==== keyofSelfReferentialIndexSignatureCheckOrder.ts (5 errors) ====
    // The index signature of each type refers to its own keyof, so resolving its
    // members needs its keyof, which needs its members. Checking an interface
    // with several bases, or a type with a class base, reads its declared
    // members while they are incomplete. Its keyof, and its index signature,
    // must not depend on whether keyof is needed before or after the type is
    // checked (65543).
    
    interface A { a?: string; }
    interface B { b?: number; }
    class C { c?: string; }

    interface Q0 { a?: string; [key: string]: Q0[keyof Q0]; }
    const j0: keyof Q0 = 0;

    const j1: keyof Q1 = 0;
